incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-p99-us-west-2 exceeded threshold (p99=1.8s > 1.2s) — firing multiple pages. See /incidents/INC-2026-embeddings
Alex K: I'm primary for the next 30m, handing off now — ongoing alert for embeddings latency. Short summary below.
Alex K: Symptom: p99 spike for embeddings in us-west-2, steady error rate ~2-4% on heavy customers, queue depth increasing on worker pool W-emb-1.
Alex K: Mitigations in progress: autoscale triggered x2 on W-emb-1, KV-prefetch disabled for long requests (temp), routing rules sending overflow to secondary pool in us-east-1.
Maria S: I can take primary after Alex. Quick question: did we enable the fallback model (quantized) or only scale workers?
Alex K: We've enabled fallback to quantized-embed-v2 for non-SLA customers only. Canary on 10% traffic. Full fallback is manual — need approval if customer impact remains.
Jonathan R: Noted. I'm secondary and will monitor CI dashboards + perf traces. I've attached the quicktrace link: https://observability/redwood/trace/eb1234
Ingrid T: FYI, support-ops reports two enterprise customers in Chicago showing higher error rates (~6-8%) — they've been notified and CS has opened tickets.
Alex K: Runbook pointers: follow runbook "embeddings/latency-surge" — https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeddings-latency
Alex K: Key runbook steps executed: 1) scale workers, 2) toggle prefetch, 3) enable fallback model, 4) enable rate-shed on non-critical API keys (we applied rate limit to trial accounts).
Maria S: Current state: p95 ~650ms, p99 ~1.6s (down from peak 1.9s), error rate ~2.1%, queue depth reduced 18% after scaling. Still sporadic tail spikes.
Jonathan R: Logs show occasional KV-cache eviction bursts during long sequences — adding sticky routing to avoid cold-cache nodes could help. Planning warmup of key nodes.
Ingrid T: Coverage gap: no APAC primary until 03:00 UTC due to shift overlap — APAC traffic currently routing to us-west and adding load. If traffic shifts, we may need to spin up an extra small pool in ap-northeast-1.
Alex K: Actions for next shift (Maria primary): 1) keep fallback at 10% canary for another 45m, 2) if p99 >1.5s for 10m, increase fallback to 30%, 3) prep warmup script: `./scripts/warmup_emb_pool --pool ap-northeast-1 --size s-2`, 4) coordinate with support for customer escalations.
Maria S: Acknowledged. I'll monitor dashboards and handle canary ramp. I'll also open a short-lived run with fallback to 30% if we don't see improvement.
Jonathan R: I'll keep traces + alerting policies tuned — lowering the p99 alert threshold temporarily to catch regressions. If we hit error rate >5% for any enterprise customer, page SRE lead.
Alex K: Customer impact note for handoff: two enterprise tickets (CH-245, CH-246) open; CS notified; public status page not required yet but prepare a short blurb if degraded persists: "We are investigating intermittent embedding latency affecting a subset of requests in us-west-2. Mitigations are in progress."
Maria S: Also — escalation contact: @ingrid.t for CS sync, @jonathan.r for tracing, @alex.k for infra changes. If paging escalates, use bridge #oncall-bridge.
Ingrid T: I'll stand by for CS messages. If any enterprise reports errors >10%, escalate to on-call manager.
deploy-bot: deploy started: autoscaler-adjust v2.3.1 -> rolling to W-emb-1
Alex K: handing off primary to Maria S now. I'll remain reachable for 20m for context. Good luck, team. :thumbsup:
Maria S: Taking primary. Thanks Alex — catching up on traces now. I'll post updates every 15m or on important changes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: update recorded — status: mitigations in progress, severity: S2 (customer-impacting), incidents/INC-2026-embeddings"
